work.text: For a long time it was assumed that the work was painted in 1330 by Simone Martini. This dating made it one of the first secular portraits and one of the first monumental landscape paintings. It is widely considered a masterpiece of European painting.

moment.text: By decorating the meeting room of the Council of Nine with these images, it was made clear that these cities and castles were now the inalienable property of Siena. In this sense, the frescoes can be seen as an artistic form of political propaganda.

moment.text: Such being the ideal basis of Siena's policy, we are now given a series of her victories. On the opposite wall, painted by Simone in 1328, is a mediaeval warrior, Guidoriccio, riding alone, fully armed save for the head, his baton of command in his hand, his steed gorgeously caparisoned.

source.author: Edmund G. Gardner
source.title: The Story of Siena and San Gimignano

matters.text: Guidoriccio dei Fogliani of Reggio was elected Captain of War in Siena for six months in 1326, and afterwards confirmed so many … times in the office that he kept it for seven years.

source.author: Edmund G. Gardner

matters.text: Over the centuries, the horseman has become an emblem of Siena which is still frequently found on souvenirs and local products.
